title: El modelo exportador
goal: Read how the post-independence export model differed from colonial mercantilism, how countries specialized in one or two products, and why the model was profitable but vulnerable.

items: Explain how the colonial mercantile system worked.
State what changed and what stayed the same about trade after independence.
Name examples of the products different countries specialized in.
Explain how important guano became for Peru's state revenue.
Use comparatives, including cuanto más... más, to weigh the old model against the new.
I can explain how the colonial mercantile system worked.
I can state what changed and what stayed the same about trade after independence.
I can name examples of the products different countries specialized in.
I can explain how important guano became for Peru's state revenue.
I can use comparatives, including cuanto más... más, to weigh the old model against the new.
